items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: A picture of Ralph Sutton. Yeah, that's me and Ralph, man.

ctx.x: A picture of Ralph Sutton. Yeah, that's me and Ralph, man. Both of us was juiced
onto the lizard, man. You see? Yeah, that's what I mean. Ralph, who is that Ralph? Ralph Sutton player. He's a piano player. He plays out here now with the… Yeah, he's

at the Easy Street. With Kirk Murphy's place. We haven't been out there yet. We were going to try to get back to your place there. See, that is… Here's Art Hody, see? Mm-hmm. And this poor guy, he got killed. George Lodge, that's a trombone player. Oh, yeah. He got killed. Run over on it. Yeah, a train hit. He didn't need a train, you see? And these two people who used to follow us all around, they got a big dress factory in New York. And this is the waiter back here. I don't know where in the world we were when…
